title: Extra Grain for Ruth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ruth and Naomi needed food,
So Ruth said, "I will go
And pick up grain the workers drop
And gather row by row."

[Chorus]
Hard work shows love, so work with joy,
Like Ruth did long ago.
And God sees every helping hand,
He sees, and loves you so.

[Verse 2]
Kind Boaz saw her working hard,
He said, "Leave extra grain."
Then Ruth ran home with arms so full,
Naomi smiled again.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Your helping hands can rest now, love,
The day's good work is done.
The Lord is near, so close your eyes,
And dream of golden sun.

[Chorus]
mood: Walking music. A light, even two-step pulse moves under the voice like Ruth bending and rising along the rows, patient and cheerful, never heavy. The first two verses keep a warm, unhurried lift, as if the sun is still up over the barley. By the last verse the step slows to a stroll and then a drift, sinking low and quiet as the day's work is set down.
